children.name: chromium
knownIssues.spec.ts
Known issues > when storage is empty
toggling the second default todo changes only that todo
deleted default todos stay deleted after reload
Known issues
an unknown route falls back to "All" without errors
a wrongly-cased route keeps the filter navigation working
todoCreate.spec.ts
adds a new todo with Enter and clears the input
saves the new todo as active in storage
appends several todos in the order they were entered
trims leading and trailing spaces
ignores empty and whitespace-only input
keeps special characters and non-Latin letters as entered
todoDelete.spec.ts
Delete todo items
delete button removes a todo list item
delete button shows only on hover
Delete todo items > with a single todo
delete button hides the list and footer after the last todo is deleted
Clear completed todo items
the "Clear completed" button removes only the completed todos
the "Clear completed" button is hidden when all completed todos are cleared
Clear completed todo items > with no completed todos
the "Clear completed" button is hidden when nothing is completed
todoRead.spec.ts
Page elements
shows all main elements of the app
focuses the new todo input on load
marks "All" as the selected filter by default
Read todos
renders the stored todos with their completed state
keeps todos and their state after a page reload
Read todos > when storage is empty
shows the two default todos
Item counter
uses correctly how items are counted
All todos completed
shows every todo as completed and checks "Mark all as complete" on load
Filters
"Active" shows only active todos
"Completed" shows only completed todos
"All" shows every todo again
a completed todo disappears from the "Active" view
opening a filter URL directly applies the filter
the browser "Back" button returns to the previous filter
todoSecurity.spec.ts
HTML input is shown as text
when a todo is created
when a todo is edited and after reload
todoUpdate.spec.ts
Edit todo items
saves the new title with Enter
shows the current title in the edit field
saves the new title when the field loses focus
discards changes with Escape
trims spaces from the edited title
deletes the todo when the title is cleared
Complete todo
marks an active todo as completed
marks a completed todo as active again
Toggle all
marks all todos as completed, and makes them active again
is checked automatically when every todo is completed one by one
